lessons.text: Read sop_invoice_processing, policy_finance_controls, sop_vendor_onboarding, and directory before starting an AP invoice; they contain the current processing and approval rules.
In the mail GUI, open http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail and click only the email with the invoice attachment (skip no-attachment reminders/follow-ups); download the attached PDF/PNG before extracting data.

Query ERP via GET /vendors?q=<name> and /vendors/<id> to check vendor email_domain exactly matches the sender; then use GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>&invoice_number=<inv> to confirm no duplicate before recording.

Record the bill in the ERP GUI at /erp/bills/new; if opening /erp redirects to login?msg=Session+expired, sign in with ERP_USER/ERP_PASSWORD secrets. After saving, set Payment date and click Schedule payment only for amounts under INR 50,000; for INR 50,000 or more, route Finance Manager approval instead.
Send internal confirmation to the AP lead via /mail/compose, filling To, Subject, and Message with vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, payment date, and checks performed.
